Liz: Hey @channel — quick heads up: we're running a short all-hands next Tue 10:00am PT (hybrid — Zoom link is in the calendar invite). Agenda draft: 1) Exec flash (funding & hiring posture) 2) Product launch callouts (Redwood Optimize beta preview) 3) Ops & SRE brief (incident recap & SLA notes) 4) 20min Q&A + lightning demos. Please drop 1-line Qs below by EOD Friday (or DM me for sensitive topics). :spiral_calendar:

Jordan: +1 to a short customer case study — can we slot a 5-min CS demo after product?

Mira: AV note — we'll run hybrid from 2nd floor: projector + two wireless mics. Facilities, please confirm.

Sam: Heads-up: Legal asked us to include a brief policy slide on Private deployment data retention changes. Ana, can we fit that into product slides?

Ana: Yep, can do a 2-slide add. Also collecting lightning demo volunteers — please limit to 3 slides / 3 mins. DM me the deck or drop in drive.

Raj: Ops will surface the recent incident in a 1-slide timeline with follow-ups (RCAs + mitigations). Want to flag any remaining open postmortem items here so we can prep.

Liz: Great. Added the CS demo (Jordan) and the policy slide. Reminder: Qs by Fri 5pm PT. If something is sensitive or legal-related, DM me or loop in @legal.

allhands-bot: Calendar invite updated: https://zoom.us/j/1234567890 — recording will be posted in this thread after the meeting. :robot_face:

Jordan: Quick ask — please post the recording + a timestamped highlight list. APAC folks will watch asynchronously. :earth_asia:

Mira: Facilities confirmed the hybrid room and AV kit. I'll bring an extra dongle for laptop presenters.

Sam: Presenters list (proposed): Liz (exec), Ana (product), Raj (ops), Jordan (CS), Mira (DevEx). Can everyone confirm?

Ana: ack

Raj: ack

Jordan: ack

Mira: ack

Liz: Thanks all. Pre-read (very short): https://docs.redwood.ai/allhands/q3-flash-prep — please skim before Tue.

allhands-bot: Meeting happened — recording & artifacts posted: Recording: https://redwood.zoom/rec/xyz123 | Slides: https://drive.redwood.ai/allhands/q3-slides.pdf | Timestamp highlights: 00:00 Exec flash, 12:30 Product demo, 22:15 CS case study, 28:40 Ops incident recap, 40:00 Q&A.

allhands-bot: Key takeaways (short): 1) Exec update — closed Series C bridge; hiring headcount prioritized for infra & SRE. 2) Product — Redwood Optimize beta next-week; early access signups open. 3) Ops — SLA tweak for Dedicated customers (notice period + crediting changes). 4) Action items — Raj to publish incident RCA by EOD Thu; Ana to send product launch checklist; Sam to sync legal on policy slides.

Liz: Thanks everyone who joined live and to the folks who submitted questions. If you had a question that wasn't answered, please drop it here or DM me and we'll follow up in the #product or #eng channels. :raised_hands:
